nodes.label: Auth & RBAC (JWT, Admin/Operator/Viewer)
nodes.rationale: Admin-only signup because the platform will eventually execute remediation; open signup is unsafe.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.rationale: Rotated on every use; reuse of a revoked token revokes the whole chain.

nodes.label: AirflowAdapter Protocol (version-aware 2.x/3.x)
nodes.rationale: Airflow 3 removed /api/v1 while many deployments remain on 2.x, so versions are detected via /api/v2/version then /api/v1/version.

nodes.label: MockAirflowAdapter
nodes.rationale: Selected per connection so live and mock coexist; blocked in production.

nodes.label: Monitored DAG Registry
nodes.rationale: Bridge to Plan 1 failure detection.

nodes.label: Async HTTP + sync DB sessions decision
nodes.rationale: Keeps ORM simple; FastAPI runs sync DB work in its threadpool.
nodes.norm_label: async http + sync db sessions decision

nodes.label: Detection Rules (detect_failed_runs, detect_sla_miss, find_recoveries)
nodes.rationale: Pure framework-free functions: deterministic and independently testable, per project.md.

nodes.label: Deterministic Severity Scoring
nodes.rationale: Explainable and testable with no ML; reasons stored in incident_events.

nodes.label: Evidence Log Scrubbing & Truncation
nodes.rationale: Preserves explainability without storing unbounded or sensitive logs.

nodes.label: DetectionLease (DB lease-guarded scheduler)
nodes.rationale: No new infrastructure (Celery/Redis); the lease row makes multiple workers safe.

nodes.label: Incident Fingerprint Dedup
nodes.rationale: One open incident per failure; repeats bump occurrence_count.

nodes.label: Auto-resolve on Recovery (AUTO_RECOVERED)
nodes.rationale: First verify-recovery hook that Plan 2 builds on.

nodes.label: Per-DAG Freshness SLA (sla_minutes)
nodes.rationale: Airflow 3 removed native SLAs, so SLAs are evaluated by the platform.

nodes.label: Deterministic Log Classifier (diagnosis)
nodes.rationale: Regex rules, first match wins; explainable and testable, no LLM.

nodes.label: Workflow JSON Graph (typed nodes, named ports)

nodes.label: Automation Engine (enqueue, tick, advance)
